assessments.reasoning: Event bacd88b28f9149d4b41baa81cfb44d72, Mozilla archive, NPL 1.1 governing revision 1, [1259,1869). IV expressly identifies the code, actor, prior licensing, contractual limit and optional reintegration. Variations elsewhere in the document supply no contrary wording in IV.

challenge.method: Tested a restriction first assumed after licensing the Original Code, a distributor invoking Netscape’s privilege, and a claim that a trademark listing in III supplies the contractual restriction in IV.
challenge.results: The required prior licensing and named actor exclude the first two cases. Amendment III concerns marks. IV independently requires the applicable contractual limit on making the third-party code available under the license.

limitations: The receipt establishes the wording of IV in this plaintext. Actual contracts, particular code and other representations fall outside the finding.
reasoning: NPL 1.1 Amendment IV permits Netscape to reintegrate into Covered Code third-party code it licensed for its Branded Code before licensing the Original Code under the NPL. The exception covers source distribution of that code to the extent of Netscape’s contractual limitation, including when the code would otherwise qualify as Modifications.
